findings.text: the new nonsingularity test uses an absolute determinant floor of 1e-12, so admission is not invariant to multiplying the same flux field by a nonzero scalar. An independent known-root check on psi=(R-0.2)^2-(Z-0.1)^2 retained the saddle at scales 1, 1e-3 and 1e-6 but rejected the identical finite indefinite root at 1e-9. The plan requires a finite nonsingular Hessian; the scaled determinant is nonzero, so this threshold can erase a real topology solely because the flux unit amplitude changed. Use a scale-conditioned singularity test and pin flux-rescaling invariance.

ForwardProfile._secondary_x_point still truncates flux at physical_node_number and calls the adopted locator with grid_flux only. On an own-node carrier the locator requires the direct sampling suffix and raises ValueError('own-node null census requires the direct sampling flux values'). The reviewed run's consumer.log contains the positive control retained_count=[1,3] followed by that refusal, and consumer-migration.json identifies this production caller plus five benchmark callers that can reach own-node carriers. The one repaired DIII-D benchmark does not make the input-contract migration complete; pair these callers before promotion.
